entities.summary: Angela Borsuk is an Israeli chess player. She previously represented Soviet Union and Ukraine. Borsuk was born in Kherson, Ukraine and made her chess debut for Ukraine in 1989. Borsuk has formally represented Israel for most number of times in her chess career.
